Red sandstone can be mined at Oo'glog and smelted using the robust glass machine also located at Oo'glog.
The animal trait re-roller is an item that can be purchased from the Farmers' Market for 300 beans.

Attuned crystal weapon seeds are very rare drops from defeating Iorwerth scouts, Iorwerth guards, Cadarn mages, Cadarn rangers, rare drops from defeating Crystal Shapeshifters and uncommon drops from powerful edimmu.

Aviansie Skyguard Wings.x: Aviansie Skyguard Wings is a wings slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Aviansie Skyguard set.

Barbarian Warhammer.x: Barbarian Warhammer is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is part of the Barbarian set.

sc: The beta scientist gloves is a piece of the Beta scientist outfit that can be claimed from Diango for completing 4 out of the possible 8 combat beta weekend events.
It can be earned by obtaining 375 potential on a bounty emblem (t1), and can be upgraded to a bounty emblem (t3) by earning another 450 potential.
It is found by pruning trees near the crates at the start of the ice puzzle and is used to make snowman for Violet to roar at.

Captain Deathbeard (Phantom) is a cosmetic override outfit awarded after handing in a total of 8,500 or more phantom doubloons to Captain Deathbeard throughout the duration of the Deathbeard's Demise event.
The full outfit, along with a transformation emote, could previously be purchased from the Oddments Store for 2,000 oddments.
It is obtained by using the plans on 50% Luke together with a charcoal in the inventory.

Chocolate bar (ui).x: The chocolate bar (ui) is an item used in third puzzle of the 2016 Easter event. Once the chocolate is folded in all three ways, it may be given to Gilly Willikers to complete the puzzle.

Clue scroll (easy) is an emote clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
They are obtained by picking them from the corrupt herbs around the area's edge.
The corrupted Ascension signet VI is an item dropped by Legio Sextus that can be used to unlock the miniature-boss pet Legio Sextulus.
Crondite is one of the Jewels of the Elid found in Menaphos.
It can be found while mining mineral deposits in the Worker district or VIP skilling area.

D'Amour Weapon Pack is a cosmetic override set that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
Your overrides can be found in the wardrobe interface.
A deathleaf hood is tier 3 necromancy tank headwear available in Daemonheim as part of the deathleaf armour set.
It is made from ensouled blightleaf cloth and ensouled thread with level 24 Crafting.
Dragon bones are associated with the Prayer skill, and are dropped by most adult dragons.
Members can also get dragon bones as a reward from the Soul Wars minigame by selecting the 'Gamble' option when choosing rewards.
Durzag's helmet is a drop from Beastmaster Durzag that can be inspected to unlock the Diddyzag pet, destroying the item in the process.
It can be obtained if the player dies and the rest of their team completes the kill.
The enchanter's echo sword is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 3 of the Kerapac Track while having access to the premier rewards.
It can be made with sacred clay at a creation kiln.
Fat snails are primarily dropped by Bruise blamish snails and Blood blamish snails in Mort Myre Swamp.
Before the graphical update of the Varrock Dig Site, it was possible to obtain fat snails from the other side of the River Salve without entering Morytania.
A fish flinging enhancer is a reward item originally obtained from Travelling Artisan events.
The item was later made available as a potential prize from opening Medium and Large Forgotten Belongings during the Parcels from the Dead event.
The flatfish & edicap potato is a unique food used in the Dungeoneering skill and can only be found in Daemonheim.
It is made by using a Baked cave potato with cooked Flatfish and an Edicap mushroom.
A fletcher's chestpiece is a reward from Stealing Creation.
The item was originally created from 500 lightweight feathers when these were obtainable between 10 March 2016 to 14 March 2016 as an exclusive prize from Treasure Hunter.
The helm can hold a maximum of 20 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.

Giftwrapped Staff Token (Untradeable) is an unlock token available from the 2025 variant of purple Christmas Present.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Giftwrapped Staff override, destroying it in the process after a confirmation prompt.
It could not be remade if destroyed, however, a replacement could be obtained by speaking to the Crafting Guild Apprentice.
The Gloves of Summer are an item that can be made by combining 600 lush blossoms.
Goblin Warpaints is a relic that can be created by combining the red hand cave painting with the green skull cave painting.

Goebie Warpaint (Red) Bottom.x: The Goebie Warpaint (Red) Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by completing Call of the Ancestors.

A grasping rune pouch can be made out of any colour of large rune pouch, retaining the colour.

A part summer pie is made by adding a strawberry to a pie shell.

Pharaoh's sandals (orange).x: The orange pharaoh's sandals is part of the pharaoh's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Rosie could also be found in Burthorpe where the player could pet them for a one-time reward of 250 heartments and a lovely gift box during the 2024 Valentine's Day event.

They can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 rune bars and rune claws + 2, requiring 1,440 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,920 Smithing experience.

It can be bought for 38,000 Dungeoneering tokens at the Daemonheim Rewards shop.
A shark tooth is found while fishing in the fishing hole in the Seal Camp during Some Like It Cold.

Spiders on shafts are sold by Hudo, the gnome grocer in the Grand Tree.

During the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame, spiders on a stick can be very useful against the white and blue masked broodoo victims since this food is obtained during the course of the minigame, thereby reducing need for inventory food.
It is crafted using the tailoring process, granting a total of 5,280 Crafting experience.

Summoning renewal flask.x: The summoning renewal flask is a potion flask containing six doses of summoning renewal. It is created by using summoning renewal potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose potion is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: A Super Guthix rest potion is made by mixing a jug of wine of Guthix with a Guthix rest (3).
This potion can be made into a super Guthix rest flask by using at least six doses of it with a potion flask.
